title: Role stewardship handoff and first-week sprintcard
body:
Purpose:
A compact, operational handoff and sprintcard for role owners (hiring manager + people ops) to get a new hire productive in week 0–1. 

Scope:
- Focused on engineering & PM hires but intentionally generic so L4-L6 ICs and hybrid roles can adapt.
- Covers preboard -> day0 -> day1..5 -> first-90d followups (light).
- Party responsible: hiring manager (HM) owns role outcomes; people-ops owns access & offer logistics.

How to use this doc:
- Copy into a candidate-specific folder (GH/Confluence link in linked_artifacts) at offer-sign stage.
- Triage items flagged as "blocking" for Day 0 during the 72-48-24 hr check-ins.

Preboarding (before Day 0) — owners in parens
- Offer accepted: HM -> schedule 20m welcome intro + 1:1 for week1 goals. (HM)
- Send welcome packet + team org chart + 3 short async videos (team intro, infra map, first-PR walkthrough). (People Ops + HM)
- Access requests (People Ops):
  - SSO invite / Okta group assignment [ ]
  - GitHub org access (team repos + CI) [ ]
  - Cloud console/viewer role + project billing visibility [ ]
  - Slack account + #team-welcome pinned message [ ]
  - Laptop shipping + VPN / MDM enrolment [ ]
- Assign buddy & onboarding shadow schedule (HM)
- Create first-week calendar: Day0 10:00 AM kickoff, Day1 09:30 team standup intro, Day3 brown-bag, Day5 sync. (HM)
- Add candidate to docs: README, RUNBOOK, oncall rota visibility (HM + Eng Docs)

Day 0 (expectation: fully setup; if not, escalate)
- Morning quick check (People Ops): confirm SSO Slack/GH/cloud access. If any invisible items -> escalate to infra-sre ticket (JIRA HR-2789).
- 10:00 AM Kickoff (30m) — agenda: intro + role outcomes + 7d priorities + immediate blockers. Template: see template block below. (HM)
- Buddy walkthrough: clone & run app locally, make a trivial doc change + PR. (Buddy)
- Security & compliance (15m): credentials, secrets handling, hardware policy, SSO MFA. (Security rep or recorder).
- Lunch: team intro + 1:1 scheduling. (Team)

Day 1–5 sprintcard (high-impact minimal list)
- Day 1:
  - Complete "first PR": typo/docs fix PR merged. (Buddy)
  - Schedule 30m with tech lead to review codebase hotspots. (TL)
  - Confirm CI pipeline access & read-only logs. (Infra)
- Day 2:
  - Small ticket assigned (non-customer-facing) to own and merge. Aim: CI -> staging -> green. (HM/TL)
  - Add 1:1 deep-dive with product partner. (HM)
- Day 3:
  - Shadow oncall rotation overview (if applicable) + runbook reading. (SRE)
  - Brown-bag: team architecture walkthrough. (Eng)
- Day 4:
  - Deliver short tech note: "What I changed this week" (1 pager) and share in #team. (New hire)
  - Set 30/60 goals draft with HM. (HM + New hire)
- Day 5:
  - End-of-week sync: unblock review, CI, infra. 1:1 to confirm 7d outcomes. (HM + People Ops)

Quick escalation map (if Day0 not green)
- Missing SSO/Slack/GH/cloud: People Ops -> infra-sre owner -> escalate to SRE oncall if >24h.
- Laptop/hardware missing: People Ops -> IT vendor -> expedite shipping; if >48h, provide loaner.
- Security audit holds: Security team triage with HM.

Templates (copy/paste)
- Day0 Kickoff invite body:
  "Hey <name> — welcome! Quick 30m to sync on first-week expectations, access, and your buddy. Link: <calendar link>. Agenda: 1) Intro + org map (5m) 2) Role outcomes (10m) 3) 7d priorities + blockers (10m) 4) Questions + next steps (5m)."

- Slack intro (to #team):
  "Everyone meet <name>, joining as <role>. Buddy: <name>. Please welcome and share any tips for week1. They’ll be onboarding from <timezone>."

- First-week PR prompt (to assign to buddy):
  "Make a docs or test fix: clone repo -> run tests -> pick a README typo or small lint -> open PR -> link PR in this thread. Purpose: CI + code review warm-up."

Interview rubric (compact reference for handoff notes) — use during debriefs and to preserve evidence for later calibration
- Dimensions (3): Problem Solving, System Composition (design & tradeoffs), Collaboration & Ownership.
- Scoring guidance (1–4):
  - 4 = Exceeds: clear, measurable impact, tradeoffs well-articulated, shipped before.
  - 3 = Meets: solid reasoning, plausible design, good communication.
  - 2 = Partial: gaps in edge cases / follow-through.
  - 1 = Needs work: confusion, major blindspots.
- Quick prompts to capture evidence in the candidate folder:
  - "Describe a time you drove ambiguous project end-to-end" (notes: what was measured?)
  - "Whiteboard: design a low-latency inference routing layer" (notes: asked about batching, KV cache, fallbacks?)
  - "Code exercise: why did you pick X data structure?" (notes: complexity, failure modes)

Hiring signal red-flags (for HM & people-ops to note post-offer)
- Repeated missed deadlines during hiring loop without proactive communication.
- Evidence of poor collaboration on past teams (multiple independent references).
- Security/compliance hesitance for roles that require higher trust; escalate to Security.

Post-week 1 (handoff to 30/60/90)
- HM: put draft 30/60/90 in candidate folder by EOW.
- People Ops: pulse survey at day7 (3 quick Qs: access, clarity, blocker).
- Buddy: follow-up check-in at day14.

Open questions / TODOs:
- Should we create a single canonical GH template repo for "first PR" exercises? (help: @Diego)
- Verify loaner laptop SLA for internationals (Maya to confirm vendor terms).
- Add a compact checklist card to Redwood Console onboarding dashboard for SSO parity (linked_artifact: CONFLUENCE-ROLE-HANDOFF-4321).

Notes from prior experiments (what changed)
- Shortening Day0 kickoff to 30m increased completion rate of access tasks from 82% -> 95% last quarter.
- Buddy-led "first PR" reduces first-merge time by avg 1.6 days.

Appendix: short checklist (copyable)
- [ ] Offer accepted + HM kickoff scheduled
- [ ] SSO OK / Slack / GH / Cloud verified
- [ ] Laptop shipped + VPN/MFA set up
- [ ] Buddy assigned and first PR assigned
- [ ] Day0 kickoff happened (calendar link)
- [ ] Day5 end-week sync done + 30/60 draft in folder

If you're editing this doc: keep it short. Put large policy text into Confluence linked_artifact. This is the quick operational card for the role steward (HM) + people-ops to act on.
